model_name: HAR-X (HAR point forecast + empirically calibrated band)
caveats: RSS has no historical archive; event observations begin with the first local fetch.
Current ETF constituents were not used; stable ETF tickers avoid constituent survivorship bias.
External-generalization symbols were not part of model development.
Daily 5/20-day outcomes overlap; use block-aware inference for formal tests.

rss_baseline.note: Initial feed windows are archived but excluded from arrival-rate analysis.
